opening: The chest pain and the rash started three weeks ago.
I have a few small sores in my mouth.
I have lots of soft lumps on both sides of my neck.
Three months ago I had sex with a commercial sex worker.
Three weeks ago a CT scan at a local hospital showed several spots in my left lung, and a contrast CT a week later showed them again.
I also had upper and lower endoscopies there, and they were normal.

opening.text: I've been dealing with chest pain and a rash for about three weeks now. I also have a few small sores in my mouth and lots of soft lumps on both sides of my neck. Three months ago I had sex with a commercial sex worker. I went to a local hospital three weeks ago where a CT scan showed several spots in my left lung, and a contrast CT a week later showed them again. They also did upper and lower endoscopies, which were normal.
